heroHeadline: Day 169: World Cup Concluded Without Major Incident; $102M Reward Package for 8 CJNG Leaders; El 03 Bounty Hits $25M
heroSubtitle: Day 169 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). WORLD CUP CONCLUDED WITHOUT MAJOR INCIDENT: Mexico's June 11–July 19 hosting window, including four Guadalajara matches under Plan Kukulkan's 99,000+ security deployment, passed without a major cartel security incident at any venue — though cartel violence continued in rural zones outside the security perimeter, including drone-bomb attacks on the Guajes de Ayala communities in Guerrero (Jul 8–9). OFAC LARGEST-EVER CJNG ACTION (Jul 23): U.S. Treasury sanctioned more than 50 CJNG individuals and entities in its largest-ever action against the cartel, formally confirming Juan Carlos Valencia González ('El 03') as leader and identifying Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo') as CJNG's plaza boss for Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco. EL R-1 ARRESTED (Jul 30): Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala, leader of CJNG-linked cell 'Los Rs,' was captured in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco — investigators link him to the May 2025 livestreamed femicide of Valeria Márquez and the November 2025 assassination of Uruapan Mayor Carlos Manzo; formally charged and ordered held at Altiplano prison on Aug 7. DOJ/STATE $102M REWARD PACKAGE (Aug 5): The largest coordinated reward offer of the post-Mencho campaign targeted eight CJNG leaders and financial facilitators — El 03's bounty raised to $25M (matching Maduro- and bin Laden-tier historic bounties), plus $15M each for El Jardinero, El Sapo, and El Chorro (Julio Alberto Castillo Rodríguez, Mencho's son-in-law and Manzanillo plaza chief), $10M each for El Doble R (Ricardo Ruiz Velasco, alias 'Tripa'), El Tarjetas, and La Firma, and $2M for Griselda Arredondo Pinzón. The listing also formally corrected the record on El Doble R, confirming Ricardo Ruiz Velasco remains at large and was never the CJNG figure arrested in Mexicali on March 11 (that was a different individual, Ángel Javier 'N,' who shared the nickname). SUCCESSION BINARY HOLDS: El 03 (confirmed leader, $25M) vs. El Sapo (military wing/Puerto Vallarta plaza boss, $15M) — both remain at large. DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13), El R-1/Los Rs (arrested Jul 30). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 48+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
